text: Hold a valid ordinary foreign passport Age range: 16 - 60 years old, in good health. For those who are under 18 years old on August 31 of the application year, a guarantee letter from a Chinese or foreign adult guardian residing in China (download the guardian guarantee letter template from the download center page) is required. The Chinese language training courses for students offer zero-level and beginner-level classes. The beginner-level classes require applicants to have a HSK level of 2 or 3; the business Chinese language course requires applicants to have a HSK level of 4.
